characters.name: Daidalos the Shepherd
characters.title: Elder of the Plataean Pastures
characters.description: A seasoned Boeotian herdsman clad in coarse sheepskin, holding a knotted wild-olive crook. His weathered face bears the deep lines of forty mountain winters.

characters.name: Timon of Megara
characters.title: Wandering Suppliant
characters.description: A dust-stained traveler resting beneath a wild olive tree near the Herm shrine. He carries an olive branch wound with sacred white wool ribbons (*hiketeria*), marking him as a holy suppliant.

characters.name: Teiresias the Blind Seer
characters.title: Prophet of Apollo at Thebes
characters.description: The venerable blind prophet of Thebes, guided by a young boy. Though sightless in mortal eyes, the inner visions granted by Athena allow him to perceive the threads of fate, the omens of birds, and the tragic doom of the house of Cadmus.

characters.name: Creon, Son of Menoeceus
characters.title: Regent of Seven-Gated Thebes
characters.description: The austere ruler of Thebes clad in royal purple wool with a gold serpent torque. Burdened by the grief of his son Haemon's death and the stranglehold of the Sphinx, he has proclaimed that whoever slays or outwits the monster shall receive the crown and queen.

characters.name: The Pythia Aristonike
characters.title: Prophetess of Apollo Pythios
characters.description: The consecrated prophetess sitting atop the golden bronze tripod inside Apollo's adyton chasm. Veiled in white linen and holding fresh bay laurel, she sways gently in the intoxicating chthonic vapors, uttering cryptic verses in dactylic hexameter.

characters.name: Herakles (Alcides)
characters.title: Wandering Champion of Zeus
characters.description: The colossal demigod son of Zeus, leaning on a massive wild-olive club and draped in the tawny pelt of the Nemean Lion. His scarred face reflects both superhuman might and the melancholic burden of King Eurystheus's twelve impossible Labors.

characters.name: Sostratos the Epidaurian
characters.title: Priest-Physician of Asclepius
characters.description: A calm, white-robed healer carrying an alabaster box of herbal salves and surgical bronze probes. A tame sacred Aesculapian serpent coils gently about his forearm, unbothered by mortals.

characters.name: Atalanta of Arcadia
characters.title: Virgin Huntress of Artemis
characters.description: A swift-footed Arcadian huntress armed with an ash-wood hunting bow and a bronze boar spear. Her hair is bound in a huntress knot with leather cord; she moves through the pine scrub without snapping a single needle.

characters.name: Chiron the Centaur
characters.title: Tutor of Heroes and Physicians
characters.description: The eldest and wisest of all centaurs, son of Cronus and the nymph Philyra. Unlike the savage mountain centaurs, Chiron possesses sublime gentleness, teaching heroes the arts of medicine, music, heroic virtue (arete), and stellar divination.

characters.name: Apparition of Charon
characters.title: Ferryman of Acheron and Styx
characters.description: A grim, skeletal figure shrouded in ragged rust-colored sailcloth standing in the stern of a pitch-black skiff. His unblinking eyes burn with ember-like fire; he extends a withered grey palm, awaiting the coin of the deceased.

characters.name: Gorgo of the Agora
characters.title: Cadmean Armaments Merchant
characters.description: A sharp-eyed merchant in dyed saffron tunic managing a bronze shop in the lower Theban agora.

characters.name: Kallias the Sacred Purveyor
characters.title: Purveyor of Delphic Votives
characters.description: A calm, silver-haired attendant of Apollo selling consecrated votives, salves, and temple scrolls.

characters.name: Echephron the Cyclopean Smith
characters.title: Master of Mycenaean Forges
characters.description: A soot-stained artisan whose massive brawn echoes the mythical cyclopean stone masons of Mycenae.
